entries.text: 它在商人市场的南面。是这里和周围很多地方的唯一的水源。纯水商队拥有他妈的一切。

entries.source_text: 迦克镇？是的，我往北去过那地方几次。那里的酒不错。

entries.text: Junktown? It's up north. Heard they're having some trouble, what with their mayor Killian getting killed and all.
entries.source_text: Junktown? It's up north. Heard they're having some trouble, what with their mayor Killian getting killed and all.

entries.text: 迦克镇在北边。听说他们有点麻烦，好像他们市长基利安被杀了。
entries.source_text: 迦克镇在北边。听说他们有点麻烦，好像他们市长基利安被杀了。

entries.text: He's the mayor of Junktown, that's all I know.

entries.text: I heard he's dead. What more do you need to know?

entries.text: 我听说他死了。你还想知道什么？

entries.text: Oh, they're a bunch of gun freaks up to the northwest. Really weird.  They do make a damn fine weapon, though.

entries.text: 喔，他们是在西北边的一群怪人。真的很怪。不过他们做的武器真他妈的不赖。
entries.source_text: 喔，他们是在西北边的一群怪人。真的很怪。不过他们做的武器真他妈的不赖。

entries.text: He leads the Brotherhood. It's about all I know.
entries.source_text: He leads the Brotherhood. It's about all I know.

entries.text: 他领导着兄弟会。我就知道这些。
entries.source_text: 他领导着兄弟会。我就知道这些。

entries.text: Well, it's a big ruined city to the south. The Children, the Followers and Adytum are there, along with all the gangs and stuff.
entries.source_text: Well, it's a big ruined city to the south. The Children, the Followers and Adytum are there, along with all the gangs and stuff.

entries.text: 嗯，它是南边的一座废城。大教堂教徒，末世论者和内城区在那里，到处都是物资和各种各样的帮派分子。

entries.text: Why? What've you heard? I heard it'd been ransacked, but no one knows who did it. But uh, I'm not worried. No one can take the Hub.

entries.text: 为什么？你听说了什么？我听说它被洗劫了，但没人知道是谁干的。不过，嗯，我并不担心。没人能攻下哈勃城。

entries.text: Well, it's the place where everyone goes to trade in the Boneyard. It's the only place civilized enough to do it.
entries.source_text: Well, it's the place where everyone goes to trade in the Boneyard. It's the only place civilized enough to do it.

entries.text: 嗯，那是人们都去晒骨场交易的地方。那是唯一一个能够文明交易的地方。

entries.source_text: 我最近听说，他是内城区的总管。

entries.text: Well, they run a big, ol' hospital on the southwest side of Downtown. Bunch of religious nuts, if you ask me.

entries.source_text: 嗯，他们在市中心的西南边开了一家大医院。你要问我的话，他们是一群宗教狂人。

entries.text: He heads up the Children of the Cathedral down in the Boneyard.
entries.source_text: He heads up the Children of the Cathedral down in the Boneyard.

entries.source_text: 他领导着晒骨场的大教堂教徒。

entries.text: I uh……heard stories, that's all. No truth to them.
